verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own materials explicitly say Copilot code review can analyze your pull requests and suggest improvements from your phone, which matches the story directly. Related claims support it: you can review code with Copilot on mobile, and you can refine Copilot-generated PRs through comments. All of this comes from marketing copy, not in-depth documentation. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how Copilot review is triggered and how its suggestions are applied on mobile, plan or availability requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile Copilot review.
